description: This file defines a unit test class 'WorkShiftServiceTest' for testing the 'WorkShiftService' component in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, mock object creation, and test methods for saving, retrieving all, and retrieving a work shift by ID, utilizing fixture data.

classes.name: WorkShiftServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the functionalities of the WorkShiftService in the OrangeHRM Admin module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of WorkShiftService, and loads fixture data for testing.

methods.name: testSaveWorkShift
methods.description: Tests the ability to save a WorkShift object via the service, using a mock DAO.

methods.name: testGetAllWorkShifts
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a list of all WorkShift objects based on fixture data.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftById
methods.description: Tests fetching a single WorkShift object by its ID.
